text:
maria: Heads-up — tenant 3492 spiked after an automatic routing flip to v2. They saw ~2x token charge for a 6m window. I think we need a short-lived "grace retention" signal + console affordance so customers can see pending charges after a route switch. Thoughts?

jon: Oof. Do we already emit any metric that correlates to pending KV/prefix cache misses?

kevin: We have route_switch_count and prefix_miss_rate but they are too coarse. Proposal: emit `grace_reserved_tokens` per tenant whenever we flip routing for X minutes. It would be the tokens we expect to attribute during warmup.

selina: UX idea: show a small amber pill on the route toggle: "migration: 4m left" and a tooltip that links to a detailed panel. Avoid panic — wording should be "expected transitional charges" not "billing spike". :eyes:

ops-bot: incident: Tenant 3492 billing_alert triggered at 2025-11-21T16:02:02Z — doubled token cost during 16:02-16:08 UTC.

maria: thanks — that incident is what prompted this. If we can expose an estimated burn and time-left, customers can decide to pause or revert rollouts.

dave: backend change: sampler/telemetry should tag requests with `handshake_version` and `route_origin` on switch events. That lets us attribute tokens to "pre-warm" vs "steady". Low-cardinality if we only attach on transition.

jon: Concern: adding `grace_reserved_tokens` per-tenant increases dimension cardinality. Could we sample 1% and extrapolate, and also emit an aggregated tenant-level estimate?

kevin: yep — keep raw per-req tags sampled, but produce an aggregated counter every minute: `tenant.grace_tokens.1m` and `tenant.grace_window_seconds`. This keeps dashboards fast. Example query for the panel:

```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) AS grace_tokens, max(grace_window_seconds) AS window
FROM request_logs
WHERE route_transitioned = true
  AND ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY grace_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

selina: For the console tile show: current state (on/off), time left in grace, estimated tokens (and $ est), and a link to "how we calculate". Also add a small "why this matters" blurb for non-technical users.

tara-product: Product ask: make the console copy emphasize that this is transient and provide an opt-out for the auto-flip. Also let's add a short email template for customers we proactively notify when >X% delta.

maria: Ops playbook idea: when we schedule a large rollout, enable a shadow-cohort that reports `grace_reserved_tokens` to the console but doesn't bill for 5m. That gives us visibility without hitting customers' bills.

jon: Implementation checklist for infra team: 1) telemetry tag on transition (dave/kevin), 2) aggregated counters & 1m window (kevin), 3) Grafana panel + backend API (selina + eng-console), 4) add console pill + copy (tara-product + selina), 5) soft-canary in Dedicated (maria).

kevin: I can PR telemetry + aggregator this week. Will open draft dashboard after instrumentation.

maria: sweet. Can someone own the canary run and a short runbook for support? I'll take ops coordination.

dave: I will add the `handshake_version` tag, sampled at 2% by default, with an override flag for canaries.

selina: I'll mock console pill copy by EOD and share.

tara-product: I'll draft the customer email and opt-out UX today.

maria: thanks all — putting this on next sprint board. Please add any blockers as replies here. :+1:
